usedFor: MailerLite Classic holds your subscribers, and Microsoft Excel tracks list losses when “Add Row To Table” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Subscriber Unsubscribes” in MailerLite Classic, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each unsubscribe becomes an Excel row, so you can see who left and when.

watchOut: Every MailerLite Classic trigger here is polling, so rows arrive after a scheduled check.
